title: Can Magnus Play BULLET?
summary: Bullet vs the Magnus bot (2800+): best of three at 2+1. Because the bot takes a steady ~3 seconds per move, the plan is to play solid (London as White, Sicilian structures as Black) and simply out-pace it on the clock. He wins game 1 on time with 3 seconds left in a losing-ish endgame, and game 2 on time too, taking the match 2-0 with the 1-2-3 tracker filled.
rules: Normal chess, 2+1 clock (2 minutes + 1 second increment) for both sides.
Bot spends roughly 3 seconds per move, so it can lose on time.
Best of three; colours alternate (White, Black, White).
Winning on time counts as a win.
win_condition: Win 2 of 3 games vs Magnus by mate, resignation or flag (achieved 2-0 on time).

opponent.name: Magnus (chess.com bot)
opponent.avatar_description: Small photo-style avatar; remake as original cartoon GM.
